fuel_consumption.source_quote: Cash settlements from fuel derivatives for FY2007 = net payments of $3,925,000; non-cash MTM gains = $12,753,000. Fair value of fuel hedge agreements at March 31, 2007 = $13,729,000 (asset).

instrument_type_details.notes: Crude oil options and swap/collar agreements for fuel hedging. Fair value = $13,729,000 (asset) at March 31, 2007 vs. $976,000 at March 31, 2006. FY2007 results: unrealized MTM gains of $12,753,000 (decrease to fuel expense); cash settlements = net payments of $3,925,000 (increase to fuel expense). Interest rate swap (notional $27M) expired March 2007. These fuel hedges did not qualify for hedge accounting under SFAS 133; MTM adjustments included in aircraft fuel expense. Percentage of consumption hedged not disclosed in item7a.
